title: Bottle flip (Beat 2 line)

opening.speaker: A
opening.text: Bet you five bucks you can't land a bottle flip.

answers.speaker: B
answers.text: Base only, obviously. Cap is cheating.

sample_args.claim: Jake lands a water bottle flip upright on the table.
success_criteria: The bottle leaves Jake's hand and rotates at least once.
The bottle comes to rest standing upright on its base on the table.
failure_criteria: Touching the bottle after it is released.

edge_cases.question: Does landing on the cap count?
edge_cases.answer: No. Only upright on its base counts.

edge_cases.question: One flip or best of three?
